headline: Russia launches more than 110 missiles against Ukraine after Putin's threat; at least 11 dead
summary: Russia launched more than 110 missiles against Ukraine following a threat from Putin, and at least 11 people were killed. The war began with Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine.
why: Attacks on Ukraine's energy and transport infrastructure affect European energy security, commodity prices and sovereign and corporate risk in the region.
original_headline: Rusia lanza más de 110 misiles contra Ucrania tras la amenaza de Putin; hay al menos 11 muertos
